figurative_meaning_en: to become attracted or inclined; to show bias or partisanship
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বন্ধুর পরামর্শে ঝুঁকে পড়েছে।
রাজনৈতিক দলের প্রতি সাংবাদিকরা ঝুঁকে পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has leaned towards his friend's advice.
The journalists have become biased towards the political party.
note: Commonly used in contexts of persuasion or political alignment in Bengali discourse.
